name: 特発性血小板減少性紫斑病

summary.text: A rare autoimmune coagulation disorder characterized by isolated thrombocytopenia (a platelet count <100,000/microL), in the absence of any underlying disorder that may be associated with thrombocytopenia.
summary.evidence: A rare autoimmune coagulation disorder c
